第三轮 review 的 R1/R2/R4 已由你修好，但你的这次写入又使“last/final 归属”字段再次过时（同一模式：每次修复都会改写最终字节）。本轮只做一件事：把“最终字节/最后修订”的归属改为**不会随下一轮修复失效的指针式表述**。只改 config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/REPORT.md 与 BLOCKER_CERTIFICATE.json；不得改任何科学结论；不得改其他文件；不得 commit；不要硬编码新的 mtime。
1) BLOCKER_CERTIFICATE.json：删除顶层 last_amended_by_attempt 与 executor.final_bytes_attempt 这两个“终结性归属”字段；保留 authored_by_attempt="implementation.attempt-2"（成文归属，稳定不变）；新增 amendment_note：“本证书在成文后只被 review PATCH 修复轮修改过，且每次都只改 provenance 与措辞字段（不改 status/blocking_code/identifiable_set/inference_status/三维/15 项参数身份/NOT_RUN 清单）。逐轮修订链与各轮 exit/wall/用量见 commands.json 的 implementation.attempt-3 及之后的条目与 model_usage.json；当前最终字节的 bytes/SHA-256 由 EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json 封存。”（英文或中英对照均可，含义必须如此；不得写“最后一次是 attempt-N”。）同时把 final_bytes_note 改为同义指针式表述，删除其中对某一次尝试作为“最终字节”的指认。
2) REPORT.md §8.1：把“四个有界实施子会话”改为“本表列出 attempt-1 至 attempt-4 的有界实施子会话；此后每一轮 review 修复会话都在同一白名单内只改溯源与措辞字段，逐轮账目见 commands.json 与 model_usage.json，最终字节以 EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json 为准。”；表头“implementation.attempt-4（当前）”改为“implementation.attempt-4”。§0/§2/§10 中任何“四个实施子会话合计/共同构成”的表述改为“截至 attempt-4 的四个实施子会话……；其后各轮 review 修复会话见 commands.json”。
3) 全文自查：不得再出现把某次 attempt 标为“当前/最后/final bytes”的断言，也不得出现新的硬编码写入时刻。yield 简短 diff 摘要。

root="/Users/wahrfreiheit/OMP/hungary-socialist-mechanism-lab"; os.chdir(root)
base="config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/"
cert=json.load(open(base+"BLOCKER_CERTIFICATE.json",encoding="utf-8"))
rep=open(base+"REPORT.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
seeds=json.load(open(base+"failed_seeds.json",encoding="utf-8"))
ct=json.dumps(cert,ensure_ascii=False); fails=[]
def chk(c,m):
    if not c: fails.append(m)
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()

# scientific conclusions FROZEN
chk(cert["status"]=="BLOCKED" and cert["blocking_code"]=="MISSING_INDEPENDENT_LINKAGE_ADMISSION","core")
chk(cert["identifiable_set"]==[] and cert["inference_status"]=="NOT_RUN","set")
chk([cert["dimensions"][k]["status"] for k in ("technical","structural","historical")]==["BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE","NOT_RUN","UNIDENTIFIED"],"dims")
ident=json.load(open("config/calibration/p05.json",encoding="utf-8"))["identification"]
chk(len(cert["parameter_typing"]["parameters"])==15 and cert["parameter_typing"]["counts"]=={"fixed":9,"unidentified":6,"total":15},"params")
for p in cert["parameter_typing"]["parameters"]:
    chk(p["identification"]==ident[p["artifact_id"]],"ident"); chk(p["historical_estimate"] is False,"hist")
chk(len(cert["not_executed"])==12,"not_executed")
chk(seeds=={"status":"NOT_RUN","seeds":[],"reason":"H6A source/linkage prerequisite blocked; no simulation or inference started"},"seeds")
chk(cert["delivery"]["commit"] is None and cert["delivery"]["pushed"] is False and cert["delivery"]["h6a_research_completed"] is False,"delivery")

# 1) certificate: terminal attribution fields REMOVED
chk("last_amended_by_attempt" not in ct,"1 last_amended_by_attempt removed")
chk("final_bytes_attempt" not in ct,"1 final_bytes_attempt removed")
chk(cert["authored_by_attempt"]=="implementation.attempt-2","1 authored kept")
chk("amendment_note" in cert,"1 amendment_note added")
an=cert["amendment_note"]
for frag in ["implementation.attempt-3","commands.json","model_usage.json","EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json","status/blocking_code/identifiable_set/inference_status"]:
    chk(frag in an, f"1 amendment_note missing {frag}")
chk("最后一次是 attempt" not in an and "last amended by implementation.attempt" not in an,"1 no terminal claim")
fbn=cert["final_bytes_note"]
chk("not attributed to any single attempt" in fbn,"1 final_bytes_note pointer")
chk("no attempt is named as the last writer" in fbn,"1 final_bytes_note no-name")
chk("EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json" in fbn and "commands.json" in fbn,"1 final_bytes_note pointers")
for bad in ["final bytes were last amended by","were last amended by implementation.attempt-4"]:
    chk(bad not in ct,"1 residual terminal claim: "+bad)
chk(cert["executor"]["session"].count("attempt-4")==0 or "snapshot" in cert["executor"]["attempts_note"],"1 executor session non-terminal")
chk("snapshot" in cert["executor"]["attempts_note"],"1 attempts_note snapshot")
chk("not the last one" in cert["executor"]["attempts"][3]["outcome"],"1 attempt-4 non-terminal")
chk("one intermediate state of the revision chain" in cert["executor"]["attempts"][2]["outcome"],"1 attempt-3 non-terminal")
chk("no attempt is named as the final writer" in cert["implementation"]["files_written_attribution"],"1 attribution pointer")

# 2) REPORT wording
chk("本表列出 **attempt-1 至 attempt-4 的有界实施子会话**" in rep,"2 8.1 lead")
chk("此后每一轮 review 修复会话都在同一白名单内只改溯源与措辞字段" in rep,"2 8.1 pointer sentence")
chk("最终字节以 `EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json` 为准" in rep,"2 8.1 manifest pointer")
chk("implementation.attempt-4（当前）" not in rep,"2 header fixed")
chk("| implementation.attempt-4 |" in rep,"2 header attempt-4 plain")
chk("四个有界实施子会话" not in rep,"2 old lead gone")
chk(rep.count("截至 attempt-4 的四个实施子会话")==3,"2 three counts updated: %d"%rep.count("截至 attempt-4 的四个实施子会话"))
chk("其后各轮 review 修复会话见 `commands.json`" in rep,"2 pointer to commands.json")
chk("共同构成" not in rep,"2 no '共同构成'")

# 3) no attempt marked current/last/final; no new hardcoded write times
for bad in ["（当前）","last_amended_by_attempt","final bytes were last amended","最终字节不是 attempt-3"]:
    chk(bad not in rep and bad not in ct,"3 residual: "+bad)
allts=set(re.findall(r"20\d\d-\d\d-\d\dT[\d:]+Z|\b\d\d:\d\d:\d\dZ\b", rep)) | set(re.findall(r"20\d\d-\d\d-\d\dT[\d:]+Z|\b\d\d:\d\d:\d\dZ\b", ct))
allowed={"2026-10-24T20:25:44Z","2026-10-24T20:38:07Z","2026-10-24T20:39:02Z","2026-10-24T20:09:27Z","20:09:28Z"}
chk(allts<=allowed, f"3 unexpected timestamps: {allts-allowed}")

# integrity
def lines(p): return open(p,encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")
for rc in cert["required_contract"]:
    L=lines(rc["path"])
    for q in rc["quote"]: chk(q in L, f"QUOTE {rc['path']}")
srcs=["docs/upgrade_review/HIST_VNEXT/05_REVISED_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md",
      "docs/upgrade_review/HIST_VNEXT/06_OMP_MINIMAX_HANDOFF.md",
      "docs/upgrade_review/HIST_VNEXT/evidence/phase-contracts.json",
      "docs/upgrade_review/HIST_VNEXT/01_BASELINE_AND_VERSION_AUDIT.md",
      ".omp/agents/phase-reviewer.md"]
allL={s:set(lines(s)) for s in srcs}
for b in re.findall(r"```\n(.*?)```", rep, re.S):
    bl=[x for x in b.split("\n") if x.strip()]
    if len(bl)<2: continue
    for s in srcs:
        if bl[0] in allL[s]:
            for l in bl: chk(l in allL[s], f"REPORT QUOTE {s}")
            break
n=0
def walk(o):
    global n
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        p=o.get("path")
        if isinstance(p,str) and os.path.exists(p):
            for hk,bk in (("sha256","bytes"),("stdout_sha256","stdout_bytes")):
                if isinstance(o.get(hk),str):
                    n+=1; chk(sha(p)==o[hk], f"HASH {p}")
                    if isinstance(o.get(bk),int): chk(os.path.getsize(p)==o[bk], f"BYTES {p}")
        for v in o.values(): walk(v)
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for v in o: walk(v)
walk(cert)
for p,h in {"BASELINE.md":"1f5b233f452468701ca2d87b3ec032be4654b070ed24e5853232c997d7d61b6f",
            "config/research_contract.json":"6f54522a4b9577fc8e75cb605b0cbfafddd62a9f6b8b474719f8996ada752c82",
            "uv.lock":"9fd79b625bed399c5231e1f51b478ebf375154132a30dd9538191156218882b9",
            "config/calibration/p05.json":"ef1371b66625ddaf78663cc1181679443d7288c084c18f54e1b206a5470bb6ae"}.items():
    chk(sha(p)==h, f"DRIFT {p}")
for fp in [base+"commands.json", base+"model_usage.json", base+"resource_usage.json", base+"EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json"]:
    chk(sha(fp) not in ct and sha(fp) not in rep, f"ledger hash {fp}")
chk("无真实进程故障" not in rep,"D3 intact")
chk("两个实施子会话" not in rep,"N3 intact")

print("hash/bytes pairs verified:", n)
print("timestamps present:", sorted(allts))
print("FAILS:", fails if fails else "NONE")
for f in ["REPORT.md","BLOCKER_CERTIFICATE.json","failed_seeds.json"]:
    print(f"{f}: {os.path.getsize(base+f)} B  sha256={sha(base+f)}")
